surface: Complete against urql 5.0.3 React binding: re-exports @urql/core@6.0.3; ports Context/Provider/Consumer/useClient, useQuery/useMutation/useSubscription/useRequest, state/cache helpers, and Query/Mutation/Subscription render-prop components.
divergences: Octane has no Context.Consumer on the context object; Consumer is a function component that reads with useContext and calls children(client).
Suspense still throws a Promise like upstream rather than wrapping it in Octane use(), so cache and replay timing stay aligned with the pinned React binding.
Render-prop components stay functions and return children(...) rather than JSX.
ssr: No dedicated Octane SSR prepass. The Client/Provider pair is framework-neutral and usable on the server; upstream react-ssr-prepass coverage is out of scope.
